image_description: A collection of vintage and antique smoothing irons displayed on dark wooden shelves against a white wall. The image features multiple instances: a brass/gold-toned iron on the far left, a black cast-iron style with a green handle in the center-left, a silver/chrome electric-style iron on the right shelf, and another silver iron on the lower shelf. A wooden handle component floats or rests near the top right.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Relative to the shelf depth and handle size, the proportions suggest standard hand-held appliance dimensions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ergonomic handle on top of molded body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible irons feature prominent handles. The green one has a loop handle, the silver ones have enclosed grips, consistent with ergonomic design.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Temperature control dial and steam function buttons on the body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible irons appear to be vintage/antique models (likely charcoal or solid metal) which typically lack modern dials/buttons. Furthermore, the resolution is too low to definitively identify small controls even if they existed.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The soleplates are either not visible (top shelf) or the resolution/reflection prevents seeing fine details like steam holes. Vintage irons often do not have steam holes.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No power cords are visibly attached to any of the irons. The silver iron on the bottom has a clean rear profile without a cord.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pointed tip for precision ironing around buttons and collars.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pointed tips are clearly visible on the silver irons, particularly the one on the lower shelf.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Polished stainless steel or non-stick coated aluminum soleplate.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The silver irons exhibit high reflectivity and metallic sheen consistent with polished steel or chrome plating.
The bodies appear to be cast metal (iron/aluminum) or heavy plastic/bakelite, consistent with the visual texture of vintage appliances.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Home appliance for smoothing fabric wrinkles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects are unmistakably identifiable as smoothing irons based on their iconic shape and context.

artifact_observations.location: Top right shelf area, near the wooden handle object
